description.purpose: GH #617: the sending half of a colony boundary -- a writer that puts a turn on a lane, a peer cell that projects it onto the declared lane and posts one frame, and a sink for the receipt it books.
description.use_when: As the north tree of the two-colony proof. `__PEER_URL__` is filled in the TempDir copy with the address of the reverse proxy in front of the south colony, never with the south colony itself.
description.not_in_scope: No model, no wall clock, no answer from the far side beyond its receipt.
examples: a turn on route 'topic' with body {"messages": [], "topic": "gardening"} crosses and leaves a 'crossed' receipt under /receipts
the same turn with an extra body field is refused with 'lane_field_denied' and never leaves this colony
